title: A fake page passes Sam's code to the real site
desc: Three parties: Sam, a fake sign-in page that sits in the middle, and the real site. Sam types the password and the six-digit code into the fake page. The fake page instantly passes both to the real site, which accepts them. The attacker is signed in as Sam. A final note says that typing a code does not tie it to the one site it was meant for.
